verdicts.V1: V1 THE COMBINED SIGNIFICANCE.  Pooled over the five independent a0-sensitive channels (deep end +0.0661, dSph floor +0.197, 12-decade line 0.000, MW break 0.000, cluster T amplitude +0.015 dex), fixed-effects inverse-variance: delta_pool = +0.0379 +- 0.0247 dex  ->  a0_eff/a0_DE = 1.091 (1-sigma [1.031, 1.155]) and z = 1.53 sigma (random-effects 1.53).  ROBUST RANGE: z in [0.26, 2.10] sigma over the studied priors (M/L prior sigma_ML 0.00-0.04 on CH1; per-channel sigma/delta variants; leave-one-out; generous/pessimistic corners).  The combined data give the RAR-class scale about 1.5-2.1 sigma above a0_DE -- carried by the deep end (1.89 sigma budgeted alone) and diluted toward DE by the DE-anchored channels (MW break, 12-decade zero point) and the T-law amplitude.
verdicts.V2: V2 THE 3-SIGMA CROSSING.  NO.  The maximum combined z over the entire scanned configuration space is 2.10 sigma < 3.00, and no single channel reaches 3 sigma either (deep-end max 2.46 statistical / 2.01 budgeted).  The baseline pool sits at 1.53 sigma.  Consequence branch: BELOW - the framework's a0_eff = 1.2-1.3x a0_DE (G193-corrected to 1.15-1.18x; pooled central 1.09x) is NOT a material finding; the equilibrium scale is NOT established different from the vacuum scale; the preference stays COSMETIC.  The z~2.5 BTFR test's role does NOT sharpen to 'deciding composite vs one-scale-RAR' -- it stays the REGISTERED final arbiter (G080 flat 0.00 / rising +0.33, floor +-0.13, 20:1 per clean point, 4 objects = 5 sigma; G190 priority 2) whose reading will promote or demote the composite at its own threshold.
verdicts.V3: V3 THE HONEST STATEMENT.  The scale question's current statistical status across EVERY channel: the combined preference for a0_eff > a0_DE is z = 1.53 sigma (robust [0.26, 2.10]), delta_pool = +0.0379 dex = a0_eff/a0_DE = 1.091 -- a real, unanimous-direction (all five channels put a0_eff >= a0_DE, none below) but sub-materiality preference.  Per channel: CH1 deep end +0.0661 dex (1.89 sigma budgeted, the driver); CH2 dSph floor zero point +0.197 dex at ~0.5 sigma (consumed by the M/L/IMF band and the UFD +0.40 non-a0 departure, G070); CH3 12-decade line zero point 0.000 +- 0.06 dex (footing-invariant; dln obs/dln a0 = 1/4, G166); CH4 MW break 0.000 at 0-10% DE (kernel 6.13 vs measured 6.1 kpc, G119); CH5 cluster T-law amplitude +0.015 dex with the 31-system 0.076-dex HSE scatter (G135).  Pool: delta_pool = +0.0379 +- 0.0247 dex, z = 1.53 sigma, below the 3-sigma materiality bar under every studied prior.  The honest status: the two-scale reading is a PREFERENCE, not a finding -- the equilibrium scale may be the vacuum scale; the decisive instruments remain registered (z~2.5 BTFR first, then DR4-K1 / MIGHTEE-K2 per G190), and the composite a0_eff = sqrt(a0_Lambda x a0_c) with a0_c ~ 1.25-1.29e-10 stays a candidate, not a required constant.
